requests.purpose: Official AFLUX documentation only; never issue a material/property search query.

requests.purpose: Metadata descriptions of AEL/AGL, formation-energy and source/structure identifiers; suppress example values/results.
Official project/provenance and terms-link metadata; no database-record or observation page.

requests.requires: A unique explicit terms/license/data-use link from the already acquired official documentation/homepage, remaining on aflow.org. No inference from software license or paper terms.
requests.purpose: Applicable archive-use declaration only; no new data/source search.

transport: Ordinary HTTPS GET,30s per response,at most one same-aflow.org HTTPS canonical redirect per request,no credentials,retries0. Preserve first access failure; stop affected route on denial and do not try an alternate host/API/mirror.
projection: Whole bounded documentation response may contain numeric examples, aggregate counts or help examples at machine level. Researcher sees only schema/type/unit/method/grouping/rights prose with numeric examples masked, explicit property/identifier names, and exact source/terms links. No material records, numeric target values, outcome tables or performance claims are requested or quoted.
limits: AEL/AGL shared-record field declarations do not prove complete actual pairs or independent samples. Derived Debye/thermal/elastic quantities can share computational inputs and leak each other. Prototype/composition/source groups need exact semantics and later frame construction. Different calculation archive does not establish no structure/corpus overlap or future physical prediction.
retention: Exact bounded response bytes and status/time/hash locally retained; raw bodies and arbitrary help examples excluded from public output. Compact own-paraphrase finding, selected metadata, receipts and source bindings only.
forbidden: Data/record queries or numeric dataset downloads
Li/Dryad access retries or alternate routes
Full numeric target tables or quoted outcome performance
